identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase I/II Study of Competitive Transfer of αCD19-TCRz-CD28 and αCD19-TCRz-CD137 Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-Cells in Patients With Refractory CD19+ B-lineage Leukemia/Lymphoma

descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
Primary objectives

1. To determine the safety and feasibility of adoptive transfer of T cells modified to express CD19-specific chimeric antigen receptor (CD19CAR) for treatment of leukemia and lymphoma

Secondary objectives

1. To measure the efficacy of anti-tumor responses after CD19CAR T cell infusion
2. To determine if CD19CAR T cells engineered with 4-1BB signaling domain is superior to that with CD28 signaling domain for their homing and persistence after CD19CAR T cell infusion

conditions: Adult Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia in Remission
Recurrent Adult Diffuse Large Cell Lymphoma
Stage III Adult Diffuse Large Cell Lymphoma
Stage IV Adult Diffuse Large Cell Lymphoma

primaryOutcomes.measure: Safety (incidence of adverse events defined as dose-limited toxicity)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Survival of CAR T cells in circulation measured by flow cytometry and PCR
